record.paper_title: On some open problems in Diophantine approximation
record.original_question: For lambda in (0,1), let g_lambda be the Denjoy-Tichy-Uitz singular function on [0,1], defined by g_lambda(0)=0, g_lambda(1)=1, and by the Farey recursion g_lambda((a+c)/(b+d)) = (1-lambda)g_lambda(a/b) + lambda g_lambda(c/d) for neighboring Farey fractions a/b < c/d, with extension to irrational x by continuity. For an irrational x=[a_0; a_1,a_2,...], set S_x(t)=a_1+...+a_t. Define kappa_1(lambda) as the supremum of kappa such that lim sup S_x(t)/t < kappa implies g_lambda'(x)=+infinity, and define kappa_2(lambda) as the infimum of kappa such that lim inf S_x(t)/t > kappa implies g_lambda'(x)=0. What are the functions kappa_1(lambda) and kappa_2(lambda) for 0<lambda<1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For each $\lambda\in(0,1)$, define the Denjoy–Tichy–Uitz singular function $g_\lambda:[0,1]\to[0,1]$ as follows. Set $g_\lambda(0)=0$ and $g_\lambda(1)=1$. For any two neighboring Farey fractions $a/b<c/d$ (i.e.\ $bc-ad=1$) for which $g_\lambda(a/b)$ and $g_\lambda(c/d)$ are already defined, set
$$g_\lambda\!\left(\frac{a+c}{b+d}\right)=(1-\lambda)\,g_\lambda(a/b)+\lambda\,g_\lambda(c/d).$$
This determines $g_\lambda$ on all rationals in $[0,1]$, and $g_\lambda$ extends uniquely to a continuous, strictly increasing function on $[0,1]$. (When $\lambda=1/2$, $g_\lambda$ is the Minkowski question-mark function.)

For an irrational $x\in(0,1)$ with simple continued fraction expansion $x=[0;a_1,a_2,a_3,\dots]$, write
$$S_x(t)=a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_t.$$

Define
$$\kappa_1(\lambda)=\sup\Bigl\{\kappa\ge0:\ \limsup_{t\to\infty}\tfrac{S_x(t)}{t}<\kappa\ \Longrightarrow\ g_\lambda'(x)=+\infty\Bigr\},$$
$$\kappa_2(\lambda)=\inf\Bigl\{\kappa\ge0:\ \liminf_{t\to\infty}\tfrac{S_x(t)}{t}>\kappa\ \Longrightarrow\ g_\lambda'(x)=0\Bigr\}.$$

Determine the functions $\kappa_1(\lambda)$ and $\kappa_2(\lambda)$ explicitly for $0<\lambda<1$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches indicate that the Denjoy–Tichy–Uitz family $g_\lambda$ has been studied (notably for $\lambda=1/2$, the Minkowski question-mark function, where partial-quotient-average thresholds for the derivative being $0$ or $+\infty$ have been investigated, e.g.\ Dushistova–Moshchevitin's threshold $\bar k\approx 5.319$). However, no work appears to determine the analogous threshold functions $\kappa_1(\lambda),\kappa_2(\lambda)$ for general $\lambda\in(0,1)$. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: On arithmetical nature of Tichy-Uitz's function
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the Tichy–Uitz singular function family g_lambda and arithmetic conditions on continued fractions; the case of general lambda is treated only partially.
status_evidence.claim: Work on g_lambda exists but does not pin down kappa_1, kappa_2 as functions of lambda.

status_evidence.title: A survey of the Minkowski ?(x) function
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing thresholds on averages of partial quotients controlling the derivative of the Minkowski question mark function (the lambda=1/2 case).
status_evidence.claim: Threshold results are known for lambda=1/2 only; the general-lambda functions kappa_j(lambda) are not determined.
